title: Organizing Racks & Shelves (R1-S3) for Rapid Counter Picking

intro.title: Rack & Shelf Organization
intro.subtitle: Physical warehouse layout, shelf coding (R1-S3), and instant 3-second counter retrieval

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 4, Part 3: Organizing Racks and Shelves for Rapid Counter Picking. Systematic shelf coding eliminates customer wait times during peak counter rush.
In Settings, navigate to Racks and Shelves. Here you can map your entire pharmacy floor plan with structured aisles, tiers, and bin codes.
Click Add Rack to define a new location code like R1-S3, naming it Fast-Moving Antibiotics with clear physical descriptions.
Assign each medicine to its designated shelf slot in the item master to maintain synchronized inventory organization.
At the POS counter, the exact rack code appears instantly in search results, enabling cashiers to retrieve items in seconds. Next: Opening Stock Batches.

outro.takeaway: Rack Management: Organize your pharmacy using systematic codes like R1-S3 to display physical shelf locations during counter search for under-3-second picking.
